interface.longDescription: Keep your selected Codex orchestrator. Change subagent models, roles, instructions, and concurrency in chat; save project or personal defaults only when requested. Includes guarded migration, explicit ownership, acceptance checks, bounded local receipts, and a spawn guard on supported hook surfaces.

Show my current team and explain which settings are saved.
